title: 第5章 合情合理第6章 你们互砍吧
content_zh:
沈二单薄的身躯一震，尬笑着回过身，“没去哪，站久了腿酸，动动。”
“是吗？”
“哈哈，是啊。”沈二干笑两声，伸展了下手臂，然后她就看见惊悚的一幕，棺椁中的女尸竟然坐起来了！
那女尸发髻整齐华丽，面色青黑，眼窝深邃往外淌着暗色血污，她坐起的动作僵硬滞涩，关节随着她的动作咯吱作响，还伴随着一段诡异笛声。
沈二瞪大双眼，抱着铲子以及被吓直的蛇一动不敢动，只觉一股寒气从脚底板直冲天灵盖，想尖叫，喉咙却像是被什么死死扼住，只能发出咳嗽的气音。
笛音逐渐急促，女尸骇人的面庞突然转向沈二，并迅速从棺椁中爬了出来。
沈二：“！！！”
还没来得及跑开，那刚爬出来的女尸就被平地绊倒，pia唧一下面朝地摔倒了。
“啧，看来还是不行。”安衍手腕一转，把玉笛收回兜里，抬眼看向被吓得不轻的沈二，“别怕，她早就死了，我方才只不过用她做了个小试验。”
沈二大口喘着气，心脏还在狂跳，好半天才找回自己的声音，“你……你挖坟就是为了这个？”
“是，但也不全是。”安衍移步走到女尸旁，蹲下身把女尸翻正，“这女尸死得有些蹊跷，魂魄离体时被此地阴浊之气沾染，未能顺利入轮回，反而积了怨秽。”
“若放任不管，时日一久，秽气侵染尸身，说不准会生出什么麻烦东西。我路过感应到，顺手帮她一把。”
这番解释沈二听得心惊胆战，“你也不怕人家后面跑出来找你。”
“怕什么，我助她入轮回，作为回报，尸身借我用一下，合情合理。况且……”他望向沈二：“坟可是我们两个一起挖的，你还吃了人家的贡品。”
沈二：“……”
靠，连个碑都没有，谁知道那是贡品。
“好了。”安衍脱下手套随手丢到一边，站起身拍了拍身上的灰尘，“活干完了，走吧，我带你出去，顺便跟我聊聊你的病。”
沈二站在原地，盯着安安静静躺在地上的女尸。
从骨相和衣着上不难看出，死者生前应是生得很美、家境很好的女子。死后被埋在这荒郊野岭，还被个变态刨出来暴尸荒野。
就这么放着不管吗？

沈二于心不忍，来到女尸身侧，轻轻拾去她身上的枯枝烂叶。双手合十，口中默念：“无意冒犯，我只是想帮你安葬回去，莫怪莫怪。”
安衍见沈二迟迟没有跟上，回过头，看到的就是这一幕。
沈二念叨完之后似乎还有些怕，对着女尸手忙脚乱一通，无从下手，最后终于是鼓足勇气，把女尸横抱起来，放回棺椁中。
还帮忙整理了下发髻，就是这脸，让沈二头大，她又没有随身携带帕子的习惯。
想什么来什么——一块素净帕子递到面前，沈二顺着拿帕子的手往上，看见安衍带着笑意的脸。
沈二没跟他客气，夺过帕子给女子擦拭面颜。待把棺椁归位，土堆重新堆好，沈二掏出剩余的几块米饼放在土堆旁。
此处无声默哀，奈何有些人非要出声。
“你还挺好心。”
“不然…”话还没说完，沈二耳朵微动，视线落向远处的林子。
安衍也在这时觉察到不对，眸光一凝，顺着沈二的视线望过去。
一把大砍刀劈开灌木丛，睿智小伙跨步出来，恰好看见提铲跑路的沈二两人，他抬手一指：“俺滴娘嘞！俺就知道这两王八蛋是一伙的！”
壮硕汉子后半步冲出来，“废什么话？赶紧追啊！”
“不能再让他俩跑了！”
content_en:
Shen Er's thin body trembled, and he turned around with an awkward smile, "I haven't gone anywhere. My legs are sore after standing for a long time. Please move."
"Really?"
"Haha, yes." Shen Er laughed dryly and stretched her arms. Then she saw a horrifying scene. The female corpse in the coffin actually sat up!
The female corpse had neat and gorgeous hair, a black complexion, and deep eye sockets dripping with dark blood. Her movements when she sat up were stiff and sluggish, and her joints creaked with her movements, accompanied by a strange flute sound.
Shen Er's eyes widened, and he didn't dare to move while holding the shovel and the frightened snake. He felt a cold air rushing from the soles of his feet to Tianling Gai. He wanted to scream, but his throat seemed to be strangled by something, and he could only make a coughing sound.
The sound of the flute gradually became more rapid, and the frightening face of the female corpse suddenly turned to Shen Er, and she quickly crawled out of the coffin.
Shen Er: "!!!"
Before she could run away, the female corpse that had just crawled out tripped over the ground, and Pia fell face first.
"Tsk, it looks like it still won't work." An Yan turned his wrist, put the jade flute back into his pocket, and looked up at Shen Er, who was frightened. "Don't be afraid, she died a long time ago. I just used her for a small experiment."
Shen Er gasped for air, his heart still beating wildly. It took him a long time to find his voice, "You... is this why you dug graves?"
"Yes, but that's not entirely true." An Yan walked over to the female corpse, squatted down and turned the female corpse upright, "This female corpse died a bit strangely. When the soul left the body, it was contaminated by the turbid air of this place. It failed to enter reincarnation smoothly, but instead accumulated resentment."
"If you leave it alone, over time, the foul smell will infect the corpse, and something troublesome may be born. I sensed it when I passed by and helped her."
Shen Er was frightened when he heard this explanation, "You're not afraid of people coming out to look for you."
"What are you afraid of? I helped her enter reincarnation, and in return, I lent her body to use. It's reasonable. Besides..." He looked at Shen Er: "The two of us dug the grave together, and you even ate their tribute."
Shen Er: "..."
Damn, there’s not even a monument, who knew it was a tribute.
"Okay." An Yan took off his gloves and threw them aside. He stood up and patted the dust on his body. "The work is done. Let's go. I will take you out and talk to me about your illness."
Shen Er stood there, staring at the female body lying quietly on the ground.
It is not difficult to tell from the skeletal appearance and clothing that the deceased must have been a beautiful woman with a good family background. After his death, he was buried in this wilderness, and was dug out by a pervert to expose his body in the wilderness.
Just leave it alone?
Shen Er couldn't bear it, so he came to the side of the woman's body and gently picked up the dead branches and leaves on her body. Putting his hands together, he muttered silently: "No offense, I just want to help you bury you back, don't blame me."
An Yan saw that Shen Er had not followed, so he turned around and saw this scene.
After Shen Er finished chanting, he seemed to be a little scared. He was fussing over the female corpse and had no idea what to do. Finally, he mustered up the courage to pick up the female corpse and put it back in the coffin.
She also helped arrange her hair, because her face made Shen's hair look bigger, and she didn't have the habit of carrying a handkerchief with her.
Whatever he thought of came to him - a plain handkerchief was handed to him. Shen Er followed the hand holding the handkerchief up and saw Anyan's smiling face.
Shen Er was not polite to him and took the handkerchief to wipe the woman's face. After the coffin was returned and the mound was piled up again, Shen Er took out the remaining rice cakes and placed them next to the mound.
There is silence here, but some people insist on speaking out.
"You're quite kind."
"Otherwise..." Before he could finish his words, Shen Er's ears twitched slightly and his eyes fell on the forest in the distance.
An Yan also realized something was wrong at this time, his eyes narrowed, and he followed Shen Er's line of sight.
A machete split open the bushes, and the wise young man stepped out. He happened to see Shen Er and the two running away with a shovel. He raised his hand and pointed: "My mother! I am.You know these two bastards are in the same group! "
The strong man rushed out half a step later, "What nonsense are you talking about? Hurry up and chase! "
"We can't let them run away anymore! "
